decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler stays close to the core offer and costs little to keep listed, and two years of presence have not shown that its value will go unrealized, so the option stays open.
The condenser shares production and sales resources with the core business, so holding it remains cheap while its market prospects keep resolving.
Its overlap with Product B makes later consolidation likely, but the holding cost is low and there is still no clear negative evidence, so it is kept for now.
The customized air cooler line fits the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and offers several models and paths for further investment, so keeping it is clearly worthwhile.

The tube end repair inserts support the growing service and spare parts business at minimal cost, so the option is kept open, although the withdrawal of the related liner product calls for some caution.
